explanation: The Visium builder follows HYPOMAP's conventions: regional-cluster names from the authors' abbreviation table, every donor x region cell as a sample with no minimum, no compartments, Unassigned flagged and unranked, and per-condition poolWeights so a region's value is the CPM of all its spots. Region names, the absence of a minimum-spot or sparse rule, and pooling every spot to summarise a region follow the HYPOMAP authors (Tadross et al. 2025, Supplementary Table 20 and Methods).
